program.name: Tokyo

program.name: Sapporo
program.description: Four nights in the island capital with a city tour, Otaru's canal quarter and a day out to the hell valley and Lake Toya.

Check in at your hotel by the palace gardens

Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens

The fifth station on the mountain, weather permitting

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Four nights at the Peninsula and then four in Hokkaido. City polish first, open country second, and only one flight between them.
expert.tip: Ask for a palace view room at the Peninsula. In Sapporo, keep the evenings for Susukino, the seafood there is the best in the country.

summary: Nine days split between two islands: four nights at a five star hotel by the Imperial Palace gardens with a city tour, Mount Fuji with Hakone and Tokyo Disneyland, then a flight north for four nights in Sapporo with Otaru, the hell valley and Lake Toya.
included: Included: 8 nights with daily breakfast, including four at The Peninsula Tokyo; the domestic flight to Hokkaido; private airport and city transfers; full day Tokyo city tour with lunch; Mount Fuji and Hakone tour; Tokyo Disneyland tickets; Sapporo sightseeing tour; Jozankei, Otaru and Shiroi Koibito park day tour; Noboribetsu and Lake Toya tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
